buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods

4. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) Procurement of Laptop 1. OEM Authorization & Eligibility Bidder must be OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) of the quoted laptop OR an OEM-authorised partn er in India. Valid OEM Authorization Certificate (MAF) specific to this bid must be uploaded. Authorization must contain: Bid number Consignee details Product model number Generic / open authorizations will be rejected. 2. Experience & Past Performance Bidder must have supplied minimum 100 laptops in last 3 financial years to: Govt / PSU / Defence / Autonomous bodies Proof required: Supply orders Installation / completion certificates At least one single order ≥ 50 laptops mandatory. Private sector supplies not acceptable. 3. Turnover Criteria Minimum average annual turnover: ₹5 Crore (last 3 FY certified by CA). Bidder must submit: Audited balance sheet

CA certificate 4. Local Service Support (Mandatory) OEM must have authorised service centre in buyer city / district. Proof required: Service centre address OEM confirmation letter Third-party service providers not acceptable. 5. Product Compliance & Certification Bidder must submit OEM datasheet showing: Model number Processor generation RAM & SSD type Battery capacity Ports & connectivity Mandatory certifications: BIS registration RoHS compliance Energy Star / EPEAT Without OEM datasheet → bid rejected 6. Warranty & Support Minimum 3-year onsite OEM warranty. Warranty must be directly from OEM (not seller). OEM support portal warranty verification mandatory. 7. Sample & Technical Verification L1 bidder must provide 1 laptop sample within 7 days. Sample will be technically verified. Non-matching specification → bid cancelled & EMD forfeited. 8. Non-Disclosure & Authenticity All laptops must be brand new & unused. Refurbished / grey market products strictly rejected. OEM serial number verification mandatory. 9. Delivery & Installation

Delivery within 30 days of PO. Onsite installation & commissioning mandatory. OEM engineer installation report required. 10. Restrictive Participation Clause The following bidders will be disqualified: Traders without OEM authorization Resellers without service support Bidders without govt supply experience Bidders submitting generic documents 11. Declaration Bidder must submit signed declaration: “We confirm that quoted laptops are genuine OEM products and supplied with full OEM warranty and suppo rt in India.” Note:- Due to technical error pre Bid interaction scheduled on 07 Dec 2026 At 160 fd wksp Bhatinda. Delivery, installation and commissioning commitments. Authenticity of OEM authorization and product documentation. Any queries, deviations or requests for clarification must be raised during the Pre-Bid Meeting. No deviatio n from the prescribed specifications or ATC conditions shall be accepted after the bid submission deadline. Non-attendance at the Pre-Bid Meeting shall render the bidder ineligible for participation, and such bids sh all be liable for rejection. Attendance shall be recorded through an official attendance sheet signed by the bidder's authorised repre sentative .
